s01837.summary: Max, grandson Desmond and aide Flo sit in a sleepy rec hall.
Max nudges Desmond to answer the wall phone, announcing a delivery.
Movers wheel in a crate and unveil a vintage motorcycle Max once owned.
Flo and Desmond object to riding; the sender is revealed as late Harlan.
Max rises, dons the helmet, mounts the bike and unhooks her oxygen.
The bike has no key; Max laughs into a cough and asks to sit a while.

s01384.summary: Armed Nina accuses Roland of selling her out; he says he did it for a roof.
Duke enters behind Nina, hand in coat, and says the bill has come due.

s01672.summary: Inspector Nell questions Marguerite and Alfred about a cracked owl base and a missing girl.
Nell lifts the heron's wing and finds a key in the feathers.

s01310.summary: Marshal Crow and outlaw Dutch Malone face off across the dry riverbed.
Lila, brother to Dutch, begs Jed from offscreen; both men lower their guard slightly.
Both men fire at once and both fall wounded.
Lila runs in and kneels between the fallen men, calling them idiots.

s01364.summary: NICU staff check babies through the night while a mother keeps watch.
Maribel notes her baby moved his foot; staff reassure her it is good.
Gunnar wipes the fog from the glass; Fatima writes a note with quiet concern.

s00894.summary: Commander Prakash soaks her feet in the arboretum as Aalto and Banks join her.
Aalto reveals water reclamation is down nine percent, not four; forty years remain.
Meridian proposes draining the arboretum; Prakash defends it as the passengers' sky.
Aalto proposes waking some sleepers early to help the dying ship.
Prakash picks an apple and orders the sleepers woken.

s00026.summary: Stasys smiles gently on his rooftop pigeon loft while discussing Donnie's debt.
Leo lifts his bucket, revealing a revolver and an envelope of cash.

s02393.summary: Dr. Solveig runs a blizzard-bound ferry clinic and learns the plow is hours away.
Low on saline, Solveig triages patients and reads an unstable man's vitals.
Prakash shows Solveig a young woman with a black-bruised arm who walked four miles.
The lights flicker; Solveig steadies the room, then calls for the last bag as pressure drops.

s00467.summary: Family breakfast: Agatha and Noelle urge the silent Boy to eat.
The Boy says he spoke to a man at the end of the hall; adults freeze.
Agatha orders everyone to eat and resumes ladling in silence.

s00979.summary: Inspector Calloway questions suspects about the Duke's missing wax head.
Calloway targets Zelenka's lumpy turban and Marguerite's still veil, finding nothing.
Percival laughs and admits the head is under the chaise, repair attempt gone wrong.

s01472_2.summary: Tobias finds a buried door and Mouse sets up to crack it while Raff counts time.
Kite radios that a second cage is descending; Raff cuts Mouse's time.
Mouse cracks the door, they grab velvet cases, and an alarm blares as they run.

s02446.summary: Owner Harlan leads four stranded visitors through his dim wax museum.
Yvette finds the Lincoln figure warm; Harlan dismisses it as the lamp.
The Lincoln figure turns its head, Harlan's smile turns wrong, and the wax figures stir.

s00772.summary: Safecracker Maura hides from night manager Tib, who senses an intruder.
Maura steps out; she and Tib circle, trading barbs about her dead brother.
Tib lunges and they brawl among falling fish until a truck engine interrupts.
Tib admits the safe's real owner is outside; they hide as the door handle turns.
Tib and Maura agree to jointly ambush the man at the door.

s01295.summary: Attorney Renata is stuck between floors and calls maintenance, worried about court.
The judge says let her be late; Renata realizes she won and relaxes.

s02284.summary: A heist crew opens a panel in a shark tank tunnel on a tight clock.
A torch beam sweeps; they freeze, then cut the seal and take the pearl case.

s00321.summary: Inspector Mabel demands Felix open a pickle barrel as Felix stalls with jokes.
Felix blocks the barrel and offers bagels as bribes; Mabel refuses.
The lid thumps from inside; Felix presses it down and Mabel writes a note.

s00710.summary: An answering machine plays Agnes's voice in an empty hall before she enters.
Agnes plays messages and recognizes her own young voice calling her mother.
Agnes announces to the house that she's home; a door closes upstairs.

s01372.summary: Briar prunes glass trees at dusk while Tamsin anxiously holds the ladder.
Kestrel Vane appears; the chimes die and Briar disputes his claim to the orchard.
Tamsin's fist cracks the glass pear; it shatters and every tree screams.

s00693.summary: Ottilie challenges a doorman who shows her to an unsettling tower room.
Calder says the east wing guest has asked for her since Tuesday; a heavy tread approaches.

s00997.summary: At a masquerade, Ashby watches as guests seem to await his signal.
Ashby taps his cane; guests scatter, Quentin bumps Madame Dupre, and Renwick blocks Siobhan.
Ashby reaches Philippa, a glass shatters, and he leads her into a dance.
As the music resumes, Siobhan quietly pockets a small gold key among the glass.

s01830.summary: Family and solicitor sit at an untouched 1893 dinner as silence hangs.
A phone call announces the constable at the gate; Captain Vane stands.
Frost reads the will; Vane insists on the second sheet, which pales everyone.
Lady Cordelia burns the second sheet, then admits the constable only after tasting soup.

s01395.summary: Ex-cop Tomasz retrieves a steel case in a clocktower on a dispatcher's orders.
Warned someone knows he's there, Tomasz draws his pistol as a man climbs up.
Mira emerges with a gun; Leonidas betrays Tomasz and the radio goes dead.

s00096.summary: Habitat commander Nadira takes status as a seal leaks and sonar detects something big.
The sonar contact vanishes as a deep note rolls through the hull.
A vast eye passes the porthole; it is a sperm whale, and Nadira steadies herself.

s02069.summary: A veiled woman asks a scrivener to write a letter without giving her name.
She lays down a ring that makes him recognize Messer Giuliano.
She unveils and asks for a letter to arrive after her death; he begins writing.

s01413.summary: Leocadia asks why her father Norman is at the laundromat at two a.m.
Norman evades after being caught watching her apartment; she mentions leaving Friday.
He passes a sock; his tears surface as lint, and she laughs gently.
They sit by the dryer and she rests her head on his shoulder.

s02054.summary: Beatrice serves Sunday dinner for two at a table set for eight.
Beatrice mentions his absent sister; Teddy snaps that her empty places are a stage set.
Teddy stands, defies her order to sit, and slams out leaving Beatrice alone.

s00541.summary: Counsel Vesper questions Rahman about the contract; Rahman notes page twenty does not exist.
Rahman declares the filed contract a forgery; Vesper loses composure and looms over him.
Marchand orders Vesper back and cites exhibit twelve's Tuesday metadata.
Rahman says he only wants honor; Marchand suspends the hearing and refers Vesper to the bar.
